coordinates: right-handed Y-up; metres, seconds, radians; row-major parent*local; CCW
numeric_rule: abs(actual-expected) <= absolute + relative*abs(expected); nonfinite values always fail

topology.analytic_closed_solids: finite nondegenerate CCW triangles; every undirected edge has two opposite directed uses; outward outer shell and inward cavity; compare bounds/volume/occupancy independently of vertex renumbering
topology.terrain: open upward surface; no skirt curtains; shared plane samples and explicit transition policy; legacy overlap is not exact watertightness

visual.matched_view: same camera, viewport, render path, exposure, lighting, material/instance identity and readiness
visual.status: No portable renderer pixel tolerance qualified. Historical images are references, not cross-renderer passes.

performance.status: No product budget agreed. Preserve raw historical samples and coverage limits; synthetic/service fixtures are not performance evidence.

change_policy: Do not loosen these thresholds to pass a regression. A new algorithm/profile requires separately reviewed fixtures and provenance.
